# COLMAP fixtures

- `cameras.json`: COLMAP's own projections through the camera models WebSfM has an
  equivalent of (OPENCV, FULL_OPENCV, OPENCV_FISHEYE, RADIAL, SIMPLE_RADIAL): per
  parameter set, 40 random rays in the camera frame, the pixel COLMAP projects each to
  (`Camera.img_from_cam`) and the normalised point it recovers from that pixel
  (`Camera.cam_from_img`). Generated by `scripts/fixtures/make-colmap-cameras.py` with
  pycolmap 4.2.1 (seed fixed); `src/core/sfm/colmapCameras.test.js` checks
  `distortion.js` against it in both directions.
